sources.label: defi.money documentation — how MONEY is made

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28 of defi.money how-is-usdmoney-made and contracts-addresses docs: MONEY is minted only by depositing supported crypto collateral into CDP/LLAMMA-style loans. Per-market collateral inventory still not published as a reconciled weight table; envelope remains 100% approved crypto loan collateral with ku=100.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: defi.money documented crvUSD-style CDP architecture and deployment registry; current per-market weights unpublished
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete per-market collateral split (asset identities, debt shares, and band-position conversions across Arbitrum, Optimism, and Base) is not published; the issuer frontend and API are disabled, so no current verifiable composition exists.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The documented envelope spans multiple accepted collateral assets across three chains, but no current per-market weights are published and the disabled frontend prevents issuer-side verification.

providers.name: defi.money LLAMMA AMM and Controller contracts (Arbitrum, Optimism, Base)

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-5 (lead ylds-figure)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is held by the protocol's immutable LLAMMA market contracts rather than a legal custodian; the reviewed sources establish the deployment registry but no legal segregation, insolvency treatment, or reuse terms. The issuer frontend is disabled as of 2026-07-20, limiting further verification.
